address: voie de l'Air Pur 207, Beaufays, 4052, Belgium
bio: As you set foot in this striking Art deco edifice reminiscent of the 1930s and make your way over a carpet of flowers, you will immediately feel at home. The new venue of L’Atelier Cuisine is a gem! Homemade fare and fresh produce are the name of the game. The patriotic line-up of French and Italian classics has no secrets for the chef who crafts knockout nosh, sprinkled with Mediterranean influences. A bite of the veal escalope alla Milanese will transport you straight to a sunny Northern Italy....
